Image 4 is the real ZŠ Sokolíkova seen from outside: the paved forecourt with mature maples and limes in front of the entrance - this is what the glazed left wall looks out on.

Brief: the school entrance hall on a summer afternoon, Thursday 15 June 1995, around half past three: polished terrazzo floor, a bench with children's slippers by the cloakroom, the school caretaker's desk with the visitor book, bunches of keys, wooden doors. The building is 21 years old and well kept but worn: original 1970s fittings, no modern posters, no plastic windows. Warm late-afternoon sunlight comes in through the glazed left wall and lies in long bright patches across the terrazzo towards the right; the trees outside are in full green summer leaf. The walls are painted one plain colour, a soft warm yellow, with a slightly darker yellow-ochre glossy dado up to 1.45 m - no murals, no painted pictures on the walls.

All doors are light honey-coloured wood in brown steel frames. The right wall has an open doorway (no door leaf) into a bright side corridor where the first steps of a terrazzo staircase go up. Two rows of plain fluorescent tube fittings on the white ceiling.
